method.name: IsOpen
method.description: Return TRUE if session is opened.

method.name: WaitPoses
method.description: Fetch actual poses of tracked devices.

method.name: NamedTrackedDevice
method.description: Return index of tracked device of known role.

method.name: GetDigitalActionData
method.description: Fetch data for digital input action (like button).

method.name: GetAnalogActionData
method.description: Fetch data for analog input action (like axis).

method.name: GetPoseActionDataForNextFrame
method.description: Fetch data for pose input action (like fingertip position).

method.name: IsHmdPresent
method.description: Return TRUE if an HMD may be presented on the system (e.g. to show VR checkbox in application GUI). This is fast check, and even if it returns TRUE, opening session may fail.
